# Fixtures

**All fixtures here are SYNTHETIC.** They were written from the labels recorded in the
research brief (2026-10-02), not saved from the live X DOM, because the browser available
during development was signed out of X. They exercise the extractor's logic; they do not
prove it matches X's real markup. Replace/add real sanitized captures once a signed-in
capture has been run (see the main README, "Integration status").
